_note: TEAM DRAFT, written by Claude on 25 Oct 2026, awaiting teammate review. These are field DEFINITIONS, not lists of occupations: no occupation is assigned here. scripts/build-intelligence.mjs finds the eMASCO skills that contain each field's search words (word search, no model), averages their saved bge-m3 vectors into one field vector, and compares every occupation's saved vector with each field vector. majorFields and sectorFields link a student's major (or a worker's sector) to one or two fields; they are the only hand-made links. Changing anything here changes the field version and makes the next run reclassify every occupation.

fields.label: Technology and software
fields.definition: Work with software, computers, networks, information systems and cybersecurity.

fields.label: Data and analytics
fields.definition: Work that collects, analyses, models and presents data and statistics.

fields.label: Business and finance
fields.definition: Work in accounting, finance, audit, tax, banking, investment and business strategy.

fields.label: Sales and customer service
fields.definition: Work that sells products or services, markets them and looks after customers.

fields.label: Office and administration
fields.definition: Office work that keeps records, files, documents, schedules and correspondence in order.

fields.label: Health and care
fields.definition: Work that diagnoses, treats or cares for patients and supports health services.

fields.label: Engineering and energy
fields.definition: Work that designs, installs and maintains electrical, electronic, mechanical and energy systems.

fields.label: Manufacturing and production
fields.definition: Work that operates machines and makes, assembles, processes or checks products in factories.

fields.label: Construction and building trades
fields.definition: Work that builds, repairs and finishes buildings, structures and their piping or fittings.

fields.label: Transport and logistics
fields.definition: Work that drives or operates vehicles and moves, stores or ships goods and people.

fields.label: Hospitality, food and tourism
fields.definition: Work that prepares food and drinks or serves guests in hotels, restaurants and tourism.

fields.label: Agriculture and environment
fields.definition: Work with crops, animals, forests, fisheries, plantations and the natural environment.

fields.label: Design, media and communication
fields.definition: Work that designs, writes, films, photographs or broadcasts visual and written content.

fields.label: Education and social services
fields.definition: Work that teaches, trains, counsels or supports learners and communities.

fields.label: Security, law and public safety
fields.definition: Work that protects people and property, enforces laws and handles legal matters.
